comparison.objective: Build two stacked trilithons from six slender blocks.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential precision placement and gentle release of marginally stable blocks.
comparison.success_condition: A free-standing two-level structure reaches 18 cm and remains released; the record body supplies staged geometry but no separate task spec.
comparison.reason: Stable construction from loose blocks is meaningfully different from coaxial tool use and contact-loaded notch fracture with retained-coil and debris constraints.
